descriptionChirho: The proper noun Shammah (Hebrew שַׁמָּה), a personal name borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, including a son of Jesse and brother of David (1 Sam 16:9, 17:13), an Edomite chief (Gen 36:13, 17; 1 Chr 1:37), and one of David's mighty warriors (2 Sam 23:11-12, 33). All 7 occurrences refer to bearers of this same name. The variant 'Shamah' in S141691 is merely a minor transliteration difference, not a distinct person or meaning. Multilingual evidence: eng 'Shammah / Shamah,' spa 'Shammah / Sama,' hin शम्मा, arb شَمَّاة / شَمَّة, kor 샼마 / 삼마, swa Shama.
